config.field.audit: Audit checkpoint schedule and bounded verification settings
config.field.targetQueue: Target queue capacity, per-target backlog, active targets, batch/chain size, collection window, lease, ticket TTL, verification timeout, revalidation budget and candidate slots. Durations are milliseconds; bounds are installation policy, not measured capacity. The queue never targets main, master, the default branch or a branch listed in execution.adoption.protectedTargets, even when it is in adoption.targets.
config.field.runRuntime.nervous.mode: Nervous detection (protected; no AI may change it): off does nothing; shadow seals proposals without effects; live executes only a measured rule’s stop step under the owner’s standing grant. Requires a runtime service restart.
config.field.runRuntime.recovery.mode: Lost-task recovery (protected; no AI may change it): off (default) never continues a lost task by itself; shadow freezes the recovery bounds at admission and only records what the recovery decision would do, but still calls its model (data goes to that provider and the call is spent); live lets the recovery decision continue a lost task, only for the cells you allowed with deckent policy recovery. The stricter of a Run's frozen mode and this one applies. Requires a runtime service restart.
config.field.runRuntime.quotaRecovery.ma: How many times a task stopped by a provider quota resumes by itself after the quota resets (0: never by itself).
Longest wait for a provider quota reset, in milliseconds. A reset further away, or an unknown one when this time ends, asks you: wait again or move on.
How many times you may choose "wait again" for one quota stop; after that the task must move on or stop.
config.field.runRuntime.stallRecovery.wa: Worker silence, in milliseconds, after which the task is shown as silent (a warning only; nothing stops). Must be below stopAfterMs; a work class may override it.
config.field.runRuntime.stallRecovery.st: Worker silence, in milliseconds, after which the silent attempt is stopped. A work class may override it.
config.field.runRuntime.stallRecovery.ma: How many times a stopped silent attempt is run again by itself (0: never).
config.field.runRuntime.stallRecovery.ba: Wait, in milliseconds, before a stopped silent attempt is run again.
config.select.baselineHint: y apply · n or Esc not now · PgUp/PgDn every row
config.panel.guard.protected: Protected setting: only you can change it, at your own terminal. Check the value below; Enter writes it, Esc cancels.
config.panel.guard.memoryAutomation.veri: shadow and on call the model in the memory-evaluator role (see /roles): candidate text is sent to that model's provider and every call is spent. off sends nothing.
config.panel.guard.runRuntime.recovery.m: shadow and live call the model in the recovery-decision role (see /roles): task details are sent to that model's provider and every call is spent. off sends nothing.
config.operations.baseline.offer: These operations are registered, but you may not run them yet. This card grants you the registered operations (and the other founder cells you may delegate):
config.operations.baseline.later: Not granted yet. To run the registered operations, on your own terminal: deckent init policy --scope {scope} --owner-baseline mcp-delegable --apply (needed again after each new registration).
config.field.execution.git.deliveryIdent: Author name written on the commits Deckent's delivery creates (no < > or control characters); absent: the repository's own Git identity.
Author e-mail written on the commits Deckent's delivery creates; set together with authorName.
config.field.execution.adoption.targets: Branches (refs/heads/...) a delivered integration may be adopted onto with a person's card. Empty (default): no adoption at all. Deckent never pushes; main, master, the default branch and protectedTargets are never moved.
config.field.execution.adoption.protecte: Branches (refs/heads/...) Deckent never moves or targets, even when listed in adoption.targets; main, master and the default branch are always protected.
config.field.execution.workTargets: The separate clone of your repository that coding work runs against instead of this project folder (one Git target: path, base branch). Never this project folder or Deckent's data; edit it in /config, which checks it before writing.
config.field.targetQueue.capacity: Most open delivery tickets the whole installation holds; a new ticket past it is refused (QUEUE_CAPACITY). Also the page size of the service's queue scans.
config.field.targetQueue.perTarget: Most open tickets waiting on one target branch; a new ticket past it is refused (QUEUE_CAPACITY).
config.field.targetQueue.activeTargets: Most target branches the service works on at the same time (tickets past the queued state).
config.field.targetQueue.batchSize: Most queued tickets of one target taken together as one batch. The batch the service uses is the smaller of batchSize and chainSize.
config.field.targetQueue.chainSize: Upper bound on how many tickets are chained into one batch; the effective batch is the smaller of batchSize and chainSize.
config.field.targetQueue.batchWindowMs: How long (ms) the first queued ticket of a target waits for others to join its batch before work starts; also the service's shortest rescan interval.
config.field.targetQueue.leaseMs: How long (ms) a service instance holds a batch it took; after it passes another instance may take the batch over.
config.field.targetQueue.ttlMs: A new ticket's deadline (ms after it is queued).
config.field.targetQueue.verificationTim: How long (ms) after it was queued a ticket may wait for its verification evidence; past it, it and the tickets behind it are parked for a person.
config.field.targetQueue.revalidations: 0: a ticket whose target branch moved since its candidate was prepared is refused (CANDIDATE_MISMATCH); above 0 such a ticket may be prepared again on the new base. How the number caps repeats is not stated here.
config.field.targetQueue.candidateSlots: How many targets the service handles in parallel in one pass.
config.field.targetQueue.reattempts: Automatic re-attempts per delivery intent after the target base advanced (0: none; you queue it again).
config.field.targetQueue.reattemptWindow: How long (ms) after you queued a delivery the service may still start such a re-attempt.
config.field.targetQueue.requeueMax: How many times the service re-queues a delegated Attempt's ticket that stopped before any effect (0: never).
